title: rubus micans var. barbatus
intro: Rubus micans var. barbatus, commonly known as the Himalayan raspberry or Himalayan black raspberry, is a type of wild raspberry native to the Himalayan region. It is known for its edible fruits, leaves, and roots, which have been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for their health benefits. The plant has been reported to possess anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, providing therapeutic actions such as wound healing and cardiovascular protection. The bioactive constituents of Rubus micans var. barbatus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
